section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces the importance of sales technology adoption and change in sales management, highlighting the growth of the CRM market. It discusses the gap in research regarding salesperson performance during post-adoption processes and states the paper's focus on sales technology change. The text explains why sales technology change uniquely disrupts salesperson performance, citing its central role in transforming inputs to outputs, its potential for learning affecting performance over time, and the tension between learning and performing under pressure.
